Bengtie: A Genius's Out-of-the-Domain Idea

Author: Shang Li Hun Meng

Synopsis: (Off-topic) (Funny/quirky) (Star Iron Man with a knack for ideas) (Start as a genius)

Lin Yi transmigrated into the world of Collapse Iron and, for some reason, was invited by the learned and became a member of the Genius Club.

A pseudo-genius who is all talk and no action can only drift through life and try to improve himself.

"Imprison a large amount of abundant abominations within a miniature cavern, and launch it at near-light speed using a combination of warp and teleportation. Upon impact, send the coordinates to Lan along with the message 'Abundant abominations are here.' I call it the Earth-Exploding Celestial Star."

"Using the breeding colony as an inexhaustible source of wet power to generate electricity and provide computing power."

"Let it be preserved, absorbed, and multiplied, so that the Comet Wall may grow on its own."

"Compile a morally-based sword of Damocles to make the newly born, prosperous people honestly practice family planning."

Geniuses always manage to save the world from disaster; as for how those disasters came about, don't worry about that for now.

……

It wasn't until around chapter 100 that the series started to get into the more outrageous phase, with the group of genius troublemakers steadily expanding.

Chapter 0 Preface: A book that doesn't follow the main storyline of the game.

(Simplified: This is not part of the main game storyline; it's more for fun.)

The book is mediocre in the beginning, fun in the middle, and highly praised in the later stages (referring to the inclusion of reader comments, and even some side stories that are simply reader submissions).

The highlights are various big events, such as the Earth Explosion Star, the looting of the Memory Court, and occasionally blowing up the Legion to see who can cause more destruction.

(By the time of chapter 300, the process of allowing the guardian to absorb and reproduce has been completed, causing the "Heavenly Wisdom Star Wall" to grow on its own.)

Regarding the main character—many people complain about the name, but there's nothing we can do about it. He's playful, a bit of a joker, and can he really be normal if he can play with an idiot?

He has the personality issues common to geniuses, being somewhat self-centered and willful. But he's a 'good person'.

Thinking about finding a way home (but not going back), that's the main theme. The universe is about to slip away, and the personality is easygoing/go-with-the-flow.

Should we arrange for the entire Earth to come to us, and then, with the help of a genius, realize a real seven-day weekend?

Regarding the content, there will be very little main storyline, but there will be some. It's somewhat like the train crew each doing their own thing without interfering with each other. It's more like simply borrowing a world view to write their own story.

There will be many original character storylines (such as Estella's money bag), but they will not violate the game's setting and plot (unless there's something wrong with backstabbing).

This book is incredibly imaginative. As for the plot, it probably fell apart by the time the original main storyline started, since the timeline is many years ahead of the main storyline. It would be strange not to change anything.

Furthermore, it will reveal a dangerous worldview; the world of Honkai Impact 3rd is not a beautiful place at all, and ordinary people might get caught up in the antics of the madmen at any time.

In short, it's impossible for fan fiction to be completely free of plot elements, but too much of that is worse than playing the game and experiencing the story firsthand, focusing on exploring the game's plot details and adding your own secondary interpretations.

The genius club's team-building activities later on are quite interesting.

Regarding companies, a company is a complex entity, and it is difficult to define it simply as good or bad. There will be some cooperation with companies.

At the same time, as a giant corporation that is close to the ultimate form of capital, it is reasonable for it to squeeze some value out of technology, and it is also reasonable for such a large force to hide certain things.

For the sake of the plot, I will add a lot of settings to the company that are not in the game, but they will not conflict with the company's 'image'.

As for the Immortal Boat, its prototype is based on ancient dynasties, so it naturally carries a favorable aura. Therefore, it's quite reasonable that it shares our fear of insufficient firepower and likes to keep some tricks up its sleeve, right? I'll just use our real-world template.

Regarding abundance, the Star God ≠ the Messenger ≠ the Fate Walker ≠ the Blessed One. The Messenger and the people of abundance are both blessed ones and not necessarily good, but the Fate Walker who actively embarks on the Fate Path must conform to selfless altruism and healing.

Regarding the Commanders, they are given by the Star Gods, and they are not necessarily destined to follow this path or agree with the ideology. Like that insect, for example, Aha gave it all the energy for its destiny. Or like the Illusionary One who fears its own destruction, or the Guardian Commander in the company who doesn't believe in protection.

And the rampaging, looting, and burning everywhere (the rampaging creature's understanding of abundance is clearly different from that of the pharmacist; it believes that consuming other life forms to merge with itself and share eternal life is a form of abundance).

Regarding the Fate Walker, the Fate Walker is not necessarily weaker than the Commander. The Star God is the sea, the Commander is the wave, and the Fate Walker is a drop of water. But a drop of water is still a drop of water after it is dropped into another drop of water. One walks on its own, while the other is given to it by the Star God.

It's like a racetrack, with the Star God at the finish line, the Destiny Traveler Yu Yu walking alone, and the Commander being placed in the middle of the track by the Star God.

Perhaps their starting point is the destination that ordinary destiny travelers can never reach in their lifetime, but destiny travelers also have the possibility of surpassing the messengers.

Like the Yellow Springs, I don't believe that a completely meaningless big shot like the Black General would actively give people power. That's impossible because it's meaningless and not meaningless at all.

The only possibility is that Huang Quan himself has gone far enough on the path of nothingness and absorbed enough destiny energy. He can take as much as he wants, and the Black General doesn't care. He can take more than an ordinary envoy, thus creating an 'envoy' that is not an envoy.

The Commander is not a combat power level, but a product of the actions of a Star God.

Regarding Destruction, the setting (deleted content) states that the protagonist has a grudge against the Destruction faction, and because of this grudge, he will help Destruction wherever he fights.

Chapter 1 The Genius Club #85; The Real Genius, Aha!

The "Divine Firmament Space City" Oddities Storage Center is a place to store your brain. The Black Tower Space Station's Oddities Collection Room doesn't accept useless things, but it does.

"Mr. Lin Yi, we need to reconsider the Earth Explosion Star plan. We will inform you as soon as we have reached a conclusion."

Regarding the matter of providing energy for the simulated universe, the Immortal Ship can give an immediate answer: as long as the Undying Calamity continues, the Immortal Ship will not stop its patrol. If the Black Tower Space Station is willing to maintain synchronized patrol with Zhu Ming, Zhu Ming is willing to provide assistance and suspend the construction of the Seven-Day Flame Wheel Forging Palace.

Luofu Immortal Boat - Divine Strategy Mansion -

General Jing Yuan of the Divine Strategy Army, along with the projections of the other Immortal Ship generals and the Alliance Marshal, gathered together. The person who had just spoken was none other than Hua, the Marshal of the Hunting Edge Immortal Ship, whose fame resounded throughout the world and struck fear into the hearts of countless prosperous people.

What truly drew the attention of the Immortal Ship's top leadership was a rising star who had garnered worldwide attention: the proposer of the Tree Sea Universe structure, the leader of the Panacea research project, and one of the developers of the Life Transformation Equation...

The 85th seat of the Genius Club – Lone Star Traveler Lin Yi.

If system time is used as the timer, Lin Yi has been in this world for 124680 system hours.

That's equivalent to 14 years and 9 months.

Upon arriving in this world, Lin Yi was able to meet the Venerable Master Bo Shi, or rather, the Venerable Master Bo Shi glanced at him and pulled him into the narrow passage of fate.

[Truth, contemplation, established, illusion, nothingness is existence; the person in the painting is also outside the painting, can the person outside the painting be inside the painting?]

What is truth? What is existence?

After two seemingly incomprehensible sentences, he was enlightened with spirituality and intellect, and invited to join the Genius Club.

In other words, Lin Yi is actually a fake genius. After receiving spiritual enlightenment, Lin Yi's wisdom is undoubtedly that of a genius in the secular sense. However, he is still far from being a 'monster' in the genius club.

He's undoubtedly a husky who's infiltrated the pack of wolves in the genius club.

However, no one outside would doubt his abilities, after all, with the endorsement of the learned and knowledgeable, who would doubt him?

Especially the "Interstellar Peace Company," that sucker.

Give them money and supplies, give them whatever they want.

They don't even need to ask; they'll figure out your thoughts and needs on their own. When your talents are needed or coveted by the company, they'll do their best to show their goodwill.

Lin Yi was thus able to travel freely throughout the universe, becoming a proper cosmic wanderer, enjoying himself immensely.

Experience the magnificent underwater world of Lusaka, a marine planet.

Witness the breathtaking industrial wonders during El Niño, the crown jewel of industry.

Experience an adrenaline rush in the star of sports, "Tycoon".

I watched an opera at "Sigma" and checked in at the "Black Tower House" to leave a message saying "xx was here".

Checking in at the starting point of exploration, the seemingly isolated world of "Pegana" is not truly lonely...

They laughed and enjoyed life they had never experienced in their previous lives, indulging in the greatest joys of the world, day after day, year after year.

Five years later, when he arrived at the Adrefined Ruins to view the ascension embers, he was numb, lost, or rather, homesick.

No matter how nice this place is, it's not home. Home is where my parents and relatives are.

After that day, Lin Yi stopped wasting time and returned to his "Shenxiao Space City".

The Divine Firmament Space City was originally the super-giant fighting ship "Divine Firmament Ship" of the Yaoqing Immortal Boat. It was damaged in a "great victory". Because the cost of repair was greater than rebuilding, and dismantling was time-consuming and laborious, it was shelved.

Do you even know what it means for a ship to grow out of the ground? The Celestial Ship's ultra-low-cost shipbuilding! (?ω?)

At that time, he happened to want a spaceship, and Xianzhou gave it to him as a gift after learning about it.

Xianzhou had a friendly relationship with him, partly because he mistakenly believed that he, like Ruan Mei, was a descendant of the Xianzhou people who had been forced to leave Xianzhou and settle in various places before they ascended to heaven during the old hunting season.

After all, whether it's appearance, name, or some habits that are subtly ingrained in their lives and behaviors, they are undoubtedly the same as Xianzhou.

After all, looking around the world, only Xianzhou insists on rinsing the bowls before eating.

Of course, the above are nothing compared to the vastness of the world and the countless civilizations.

There are always some similarities between civilizations, but the stories and stories are different. No matter how similar the civilizations are, the people and events within them will always be somewhat different.

The use of allusions is also consistent with that of the Fairy Boat, so it's basically a no-brainer.

He soon grew tired of the giant ship that the fairy boat had gifted him and commissioned the company to modify it.

The company misunderstood his meaning and transformed the Shenxiao ship into a giant research center, modeled after the "Black Tower Space Station".

After Lin Yi returned to his "Shenxiao Space City", he began to look for his way home. He firmly believed that if he could come, he could go back, as long as he could find his way back.

At the same time, he used his genius as a pretext to recruit countless elites from all over the world to provide him with assistance.

And among his many achievements—

The configuration of the Tree Sea universe is self-evident. The Tree of Imaginary Numbers and the Sea of ​​Quanta were deduced from the result to the cause at the beginning of his journey.

The argumentation process demonstrated that the "Tree Sea Theory," which is well-known to Mijia users, is largely unfounded, and over the years he has vaguely sensed that this theory may not be entirely applicable to Bengtie.

The panacea was his first truly significant achievement.

The concept was proposed and Lin Yi was in charge of overall coordination.

Yu Qingtu and Ruan Mei jointly demonstrated the feasibility and provided theoretical support.

The five geniuses, Heita, Luosigumu, Ruan Mei, Yu Qingtu, and Lin Yi, conducted joint research.

The company provides a continuous stream of funds and materials.

Xianzhou shares medical technology and research on abundance.

The wandering knights and other factions also found various rare and precious specimens during their travels and donated them free of charge.

Even an Envoy of Abundance was involved, and her task was the most arduous and important, because she was responsible for being studied.

A "panacea" is a medicine that can completely cure all diseases and abnormalities. Various parties work together, each with their own goals.

What geniuses ultimately want is to find incurable diseases with a panacea, which is very contradictory—to find incurable diseases with a cure for everything.

The development of universal drugs is merely a screening process.

The screening process identifies incurable diseases that do not exist in the theoretical framework, and these incurable diseases are the manifestation of the Star God's intervention.

The Black Tower was created to improve the simulated universe and to study the Star Gods.

In order to help the Black Tower perfect its simulated universe, Lin Yi needs the help of the simulated universe to find the way he came. The best way is not to seek help from the Venerable Master Bo Shi.

He also has some research that requires the help of a simulated universe.

Ruan Mei would not refuse research involving the essence of life and the stars.

Screw Goom sought to deeply understand the essence of organic and inorganic life, to eradicate the lingering effects of Rupert's Imperial Wars, and to find a way for the two to truly coexist peacefully.

As for Yu Qingtu? This "Genius Club #55" lady who drinks alcohol and uses toothpaste—perhaps it was more due to the persuasion of her good friend Ruan Mei?

The "Equation of Life" was one of the byproducts of the brainstorming among people while researching a panacea.

Strictly speaking, the "Equation of Life" should be divided into two parts: "Mechanical Ascension" and "Flesh and Blood Transformation".

The name was chosen by Lin Yi, but Luo Sigumu objected to it, and it was ultimately decided by vote.

"Mechanical Ascension" means replacing the physical body with a digital form, converting consciousness into data, and transforming organic life into inorganic life.

"Flesh and Blood Transformation," on the contrary, reinterprets data thinking into a soul and creates the most suitable body for the soul, transforming inorganic life into organic life.

(The chapters have been split, so there may be some discrepancies between the titles and the content. The titles are not yet fully corrected, but most of them should appear in the next chapter.)

Chapter 2 Swarm Power Generation and Canned Food

At the same time, the "Equation of Life" has an extremely powerful effect, so powerful that even geniuses consider it heaven-defying—

It imbues ordinary mechanical creations with spirit, and gives wisdom to mindless flowers, birds, insects, and fish.

That is, to create a completely new intellectual life.

The power of the Creator was so easily seized by geniuses.

Lin Yi only mentioned it briefly, and Luo Si and Ruan Mei came up with such an outrageous thing. They can only say that they are geniuses.
